card.name: Small words in fixed label phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words or punctuation inside stock phrases, such as "call a" before doctor in overdose warnings, and "medical" in "symptomatic treatment and medical monitoring". Also the period and "by" after "Dist" in audiobook credits.

modes.label: Overdose warning
modes.description: The word "a" in "call a doctor or poison control center" at the end of the child-safety warning.
modes.example: In case of accidental overdose, call<< a>> doctor or poison control center immediately.

modes.label: Neuroleptic syndrome management
modes.description: The word "medical" in the list of treatment steps before "monitoring".

modes.label: Audiobook distributor credit
modes.description: The period or "by" after the abbreviation "Dist" in a library audiobook listing.
modes.example: Prod. by Listening Library. Dist.<< by>> Listening Library/Books on Tape.
